manifest_note: Certification Package manifest. FRC-CSO-PKG defines the initial FedRAMP 20x Certification Package as the Certification Package Overview (CPO), the Security Decision Record (SDR) implementation/validation/assessment information, and a real or example Ongoing Certification Report (OCR); Class B/C offerings also have a Secure Configuration Guide (SCG) and certification-data-sharing obligations. This file records which of those artifacts this repository generates today and which are planned, so a reader is never left assuming SDR output is a complete package. It is a scope statement, not a compliance claim. Nothing here asserts any artifact is complete, correct, or certified.

certification_package_overview.note: Generated by validation/scripts/build_cpo.py from the offering profile and validated against the official CPO schema (validate_package.py). Provider values are honest TBD placeholders until filled.

security_decision_record.note: Schema-valid JSON plus human-readable text. Required SDR-CSO-FRR / SDR-CSX-KSI / SDR-CSX-KMT semantic items are carried in providerExtensions.xFedRampSemantic and validated by the semantic_completeness_cr26 gate. Content ships as TBD until a provider fills it.

ongoing_certification_report.note: An EXAMPLE OCR is generated by validation/scripts/build_ocr.py and validated against the official OCR schema. FRC-CSO-PKG requires a real-or-example OCR in the initial package; this satisfies the example. A provider replaces the EXAMPLE-prefixed summaries with real ones and regenerates every 3 months (CCM-OCR-AVL).

secure_configuration_guide.note: A Markdown scaffold is generated by validation/scripts/build_scg.py with the required sections (secure configuration recommendations SCG-CSO-RSC, covering top-level administrative account access/config/operation/decommission; and use instructions SCG-CSO-AUP, explaining how to obtain and use the guide) and TBD placeholders. FedRAMP publishes no JSON schema for the SCG (it is a human-readable guide referenced from the CPO), so this is not schema-validated; the provider fills the TBD sections.

certification_data_sharing.note: CDS-CSO-CBF (JSON and human-readable stay in sync) is supported by the paired SDR outputs. CDS-CSO-UTC requires a FedRAMP-compatible trust center and CDS-CSO-AVR requires a Class C availability service; neither is implemented by this repository, and a public GitHub Pages site is not a trust center.

external_assessment_materials.note: FRC-CLA-ASF (MUST): Class A providers must have completed a certification or equivalent process, including an independent assessment if applicable, from an alternative security framework (e.g. SOC 2 Type II, FedRAMP Ready, GovRAMP) within the past 12 months. FRC-CLA-EAM (MUST): the provider must supply those External Assessment Materials to all necessary parties. This repository does NOT store confidential assessment reports; the materials are modeled as references in profiles/common/offering-profile.json (external_assessment: framework, assessment_date, assessor, materials[] with type/uri/sha256/bridge-or-gap-letter/next-assessment-date). `sdr.py preflight` blocks a Class A submission until these are populated. FRC-CLA-IVV (MAY): a Class A package may additionally be independently verified and validated before submission.

incident_reports.note: One unified incident-report schema covers three report types via the reportType enum: Initial (IEC-CSO-IIR), Ongoing (IEC-CSO-OIR), Final (IEC-CSO-FIR). One example of each is generated by validation/scripts/build_events.py and validated against the schema; the same providerTrackingId ties the three reports for one incident together, and Final carries resolvedAt as the schema requires.

significant_change_notification.note: Example scaffold, validated against the official SCN schema. SCN-CSO-HRM (MUST) requires all Significant Change Notifications and related audit records to be available in BOTH human-readable and JSON formats, so a paired .md is generated alongside the .json.

vulnerability_reporting.note: Accepted-vulnerability information, vulnerability detail reports, and historical VER activity are generated as example scaffolds, each validated against its official schema. Empty arrays attest none-this-period per the schemas.

oscal.note: No CR26 rule makes OSCAL the native 20x SDR submission format. This is a derived interoperability export only, not a FedRAMP 20x submission artifact.
